Overview

Kemerovo is a city in Kemerovo Oblast with a population of 550,000. The capital of the Kuzbass coal mining region, an industrial city in southwestern Siberia with a developing cultural scene. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 4a growing zone supports Cold — cool-season crops, hardy perennials. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher.
